leadText: Aeos Energy (Japanese: エオスエナジー Aeos Energy) is the first chapter of Pokémon UNITE Manga - Come On Over to Aeos Island!. It was released together with the second chapter, Zirco's Holowear, on May 13, 2022 in Asia and on May 17, 2022 internationally. It is four pages long.
plainText:
Aeos Energy (Japanese: エオスエナジー Aeos Energy) is the first chapter of Pokémon UNITE Manga - Come On Over to Aeos Island!. It was released together with the second chapter, Zirco's Holowear, on May 13, 2022 in Asia and on May 17, 2022 internationally. It is four pages long.

==Plot==
Professor Phorus recalls that when she was just a young girl, she and her Beldum played with the other wild Pokémon on Aeos Island. One particular day, she held a race between Beldum and a Scorbunny. As they ran, the two appeared to evolve into their final forms of and . This event was the first step on Phorus's path of becoming a researcher of Aeos energy. Her Beldum also assisted her, evolving into a Metagross for real as time passed.

In the present, Phorus explained the unique properties of Aeos energy to a gathered group at a Unite Battle Committee event. Erbie, the Chief of Operations, says that he and Phorus together created Unite Battles as a means to harness Aeos energy's increased power when Pokémon with Trainers compete against each other. This concludes with a final statement hoping that everyone can have fun in Unite Battles, prompting a cheer from the crowd.

Professor Phorus additionally detailed her view that Aeos energy should be used for the benefit of all, and that she and Erbie have many special events and tournaments planned for participants.

==Major events==
Unite Battles are introduced.

==Trivia==
Logos for , as well as the map of Remoat Stadium, are seen on the screens behind Phorus and Erbie. As later chapters will indicate, many of the assets of the Pokémon UNITE game are used in the fictional world.
Keep an eye on the backgrounds. Incidental characters often wear items taken directly from Pokémon UNITE. In this case, the Purple Unite Set, Eldegoss Set, and the Snorlax Set, are present. One other set could not be identified by name, but its a visual match for various Holowear of the Dark Suit Style, and was included in the Agent of Disaster Battle Pass.
Other items include the Straw Hat (Off-White) and the Orange Unite Set: Headwear.
